thread:
Anna: Quick heads-up — I'm on call for the Thurs sprint so I need someone to take the weekend deploy slot. I'm planning a dry-run for CR-4123 (user-profile DB migration behind a feature flag). Who can own smoke checks + rollback verification?

Kevin: I can cover the slot if no time conflict. What's the rollback plan?

Anna: Thanks! Rollback is reversible via a SQL rollback script + feature-flag flip. Runbook snippet: 
```
-- rollback (run on pg primary)
psql -c "SELECT * FROM migrations WHERE id=4123;" && psql -f rollback_4123.sql
kubectl rollout undo deployment/user-service -n prod
```
We should also do a canary (10% traffic) for ~30m before full roll.

Maria: +1 for Kevin owning smoke. I'll pair during the dry run Thurs 15:00 PT. Can we add a quick perf check for the tokenization path (recent change)?

Kevin: Works for me. Please add the perf check script to the runbook and confirm the feature-flag name.

Anna: Flag is `ff.user_profile_mig_4123`. Perf script lives at `infra/qa/smoke/token-check.sh`. Short checklist in runbook: 1) DB snapshot, 2) deploy canary 10%, 3) smoke tests (login, profile update, search), 4) monitor 5xx/latency for 15m, 5) flip flag to full, 6) post-deploy migration verify.

Sam: FYI, deploy-bot reserved the slot: :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Slot reserved for Kevin on 2026-03-21 02:00:00 UTC. Reminder set 1 hour prior.

Jia: If we hit schema lock issues, fallback is to run migration on a replica and promote later — see `migrations/strategy.md`. Ensure backups are taken before step 1.

Kevin: I'll run the dry run Thurs 15:00 PT with Maria and post smoke logs here. I'll mark ✅ when rollback verification completes. Can someone own the post-deploy 30m verification window?

Maria: I can take the 30m watch; will escalate to infra and @eng-oncall if errors >3% or latency spike.

Anna: Great — I'm tagging @eng-oncall for awareness and adding the checklist to the release ticket: https://rwd-inf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123

Kevin: One last ask — who can sign off release notes? I can draft them but need product to review.

Anna: I'll ping product for a quick review, thanks everyone :rocket:
